title: Top 10 Best Free Earning Apps In India 2026
summary: Top 10 best free earning apps in India 2026 — genuine apps that pay without any investment, typical earnings, numbered steps to start, and safety tips.
body_markdown:
A genuine **free earning app** has one defining trait: it never asks for your money. You download it free, use it free, and earn from real work — tasks, surveys, referrals, cashback, or commissions — with rewards paid to your UPI, bank account, or as gift cards. In 2026, dozens of apps fit that description, but they differ wildly in how much they pay and how honest their models are — see our full roundup of[legitimate apps to earn money](https://gromo.in/blog/top-legitimate-apps-to-earn-money-in-2026/) for the wider landscape.


This guide covers the 10 best free earning apps in India — what each actually pays, how the earning works, and numbered steps to start on each one. All ten are genuine[earning apps without investment](https://gromo.in/blog/earning-apps-without-investment/) — free to join; where an app has trade-offs (small payouts, data considerations), we say so plainly, because a free app should never cost you anything hidden either.


## 1. GroMo — Earn Commissions on Financial Products


**Earning type: bank-paid commissions | Typical earning: ₹5,000–₹30,000+/month | Payout: bank account**


GroMo tops this list because it is completely free *and* pays amounts no reward app can match. Instead of points and paise-per-task, you earn commissions for helping people get real financial products — savings accounts, credit cards, loans, and demat accounts from[India's leading banks](https://gromo.in/blog/is-gromo-real-or-fake/) . A single approved credit card referral pays ₹1,000–₹2,000+, and there are no targets, shifts, or fees — the free in-app training teaches you everything before you start.


**How to start on GroMo:**


1. Download the GroMo app and register free with your phone number.
2. Complete the quick one-time verification and free training.
3. Pick a product and share its application link with someone who needs it.
4. Track the application in-app; the commission credits after approval.


## 2. Freecash — Games, Offers and Surveys


**Earning type: tasks, game offers, surveys | Typical earning: ₹500–₹5,000/month | Payout: UPI, PayPal, crypto, gift cards**


Freecash pays for completing app and game offers ("reach level 10 in X"), surveys, and sign-up tasks. Rewards per offer are clearly listed upfront, and bigger game offers can pay a few hundred rupees each — but read each offer's conditions carefully, as game tasks can take hours longer than they look.


**How to start on Freecash:**


1. Sign up free with email or Google.
2. Browse offers and pick short, clearly-defined tasks first.
3. Complete the offer exactly as its conditions describe.
4. Withdraw once you cross the minimum payout threshold.


## 3. TaskPlanet — Micro-Tasks and Referrals


**Earning type: micro-tasks, social tasks, referrals | Typical earning: ₹300–₹3,000/month | Payout: UPI/bank**


TaskPlanet is an Indian[complete-task-and-earn app](https://gromo.in/blog/complete-task-and-earn-money/) : subscribe-and-like tasks, app downloads, reviews, and a referral program. Individual tasks pay small amounts, so treat it as spare-time pocket money — its strength is that tasks are simple, phone-only, and always available.


**How to start on TaskPlanet:**


1. Download the app and create a free account.
2. Open the tasks section and complete a few starter tasks.
3. Submit proofs where asked and watch your wallet credit.
4. Withdraw to UPI once you reach the minimum balance.


## 4. CashKaro — Cashback on Shopping You Already Do


**Earning type: cashback + referral override | Typical earning: ₹200–₹2,000/month (more for heavy shoppers) | Payout: bank, UPI, gift cards**


CashKaro pays real cashback when you shop at Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio and 1,500+ stores through its links — money back on spending you were doing anyway, which makes it the most effortless entry on this list. Its refer-and-earn adds 10% of your friends' cashback, forever.


**How to start on CashKaro:**


1. Sign up free with your phone or email.
2. Search the store you're about to shop at.
3. Click through CashKaro's link and shop normally.
4. Cashback tracks in 24–72 hours; transfer to bank once confirmed.


## 5. EarnKaro — Share Deals, Earn Commission


**Earning type: affiliate commissions | Typical earning: ₹1,000–₹15,000/month | Payout: bank transfer**


EarnKaro flips CashKaro's model outward: convert any product link into your "profit link", share it in WhatsApp and Telegram deal groups, and earn commission whenever anyone buys. No KYC, no investment, and earnings scale with how consistently you share good deals.


**How to start on EarnKaro:**


1. Register free on the app.
2. Pick a trending deal or paste any product link to convert it.
3. Share your profit link where people actually shop.
4. Commissions confirm after the return window and pay to your bank.


## 6. PaidWork — Surveys, Games and Data Tasks


**Earning type: surveys, games, typing and data tasks | Typical earning: ₹400–₹4,000/month | Payout: bank/PayPal/gift cards**


PaidWork bundles several earning modes — surveys, game offers, watching videos, and simple data tasks — into one free app with a single balance. Per-task pay is modest; the variety is the appeal, since something is always available whenever you have ten free minutes.


**How to start on PaidWork:**


1. Create a free account in the app.
2. Try each earning mode once to find what suits you.
3. Focus on the mode with the best pay-per-minute for you.
4. Cash out after reaching the minimum payout.


## 7. GiveRefer — Earn from Referral Deals


**Earning type: referral tasks and deals | Typical earning: ₹300–₹3,000/month | Payout: UPI/bank**


GiveRefer aggregates refer-and-earn offers from different apps into one place, so you can pick referral deals, share codes, and earn per successful signup without hunting for offers app by app. Rewards depend entirely on the live deals listed, so amounts vary month to month.


**How to start on GiveRefer:**


1. Sign up free and browse the live referral deals.
2. Pick offers whose apps genuinely suit your friends.
3. Share your referral code or link for that deal.
4. Earn when your referral completes the qualifying action.


## 8. Pawns.app — Surveys and Internet Sharing


**Earning type: surveys + passive bandwidth sharing | Typical earning: ₹300–₹2,500/month | Payout: PayPal/gift cards (dollar-based)**


Pawns.app pays for surveys and — its unusual feature — for sharing your unused internet bandwidth, which earns passively while the app runs. Be aware of what that means: your connection is used by third parties for their traffic. Use it only on unlimited plans, understand the privacy trade-off, and treat the passive income as small supplemental dollars, not a main earner.


**How to start on Pawns.app:**


1. Register free with email.
2. Complete profile surveys to unlock better-paying ones.
3. Optionally enable internet sharing on an unlimited data connection.
4. Withdraw once you reach the minimum (usually a few dollars).


## 9. Google Opinion Rewards — Micro-Surveys from Google


**Earning type: 10–30 second surveys | Typical earning: ₹50–₹500/month | Payout: Google Play credit**


The most trustworthy micro-earner on any list — Google itself asks short questions ("Which store did you visit?", ad feedback) and pays per response. Earnings are small and arrive as Play credit rather than cash, but it takes seconds, is completely safe, and funds your apps, games, and subscriptions.


**How to start on Google Opinion Rewards:**


1. Install the app and sign in with your Google account.
2. Answer the setup questions honestly.
3. Respond to surveys as notifications arrive.
4. Spend accumulated credit on Google Play automatically.


## 10. PollPe — Indian Polls and Opinions


**Earning type: polls, surveys, tasks | Typical earning: ₹200–₹2,000/month | Payout: UPI, Paytm, gift vouchers**


PollPe is an Indian opinion-rewards app: quick polls and surveys about brands and daily life, paid in points that convert to UPI cash or vouchers. Indian-context surveys mean fewer disqualifications than on global panels, and payout minimums are low.


**How to start on PollPe:**


1. Download the app and sign up free.
2. Fill your profile so surveys match you.
3. Answer polls consistently to unlock higher-value surveys.
4. Redeem points to UPI or vouchers at the low minimum.


## Important Safety Tips


- **Never pay to join:** real earning apps are 100% free to download and use. Avoid any app that asks for an upfront fee or deposit — that is the single clearest scam signal.
- **Manage expectations:** most reward apps offer small pocket money, not a replacement for a full-time job. The exception class is commission platforms like GroMo, where earning scales with real product referrals — but even there, income depends on your effort and network.
- **Protect your data:** never share financial passwords, OTPs, or sensitive personal details with unverified reward apps. A legitimate app needs, at most, your UPI ID to pay you.


## Which Free Earning App Should You Pick?


- **Want real income, not pocket money?** GroMo (#1) — commissions of ₹500–₹2,000 per approved product beat months of task rewards.
- **[Students with spare time between classes](https://gromo.in/blog/earn-money-online-for-students/) ?** Google Opinion Rewards, PollPe, and TaskPlanet — zero-skill, phone-only, exam-pausable.
- **Already shop online?** CashKaro passively, EarnKaro actively.
- **Enjoy games and offers?** Freecash and PaidWork — just read each offer's fine print first.
- **The sensible stack:** one commission earner (GroMo) + one cashback app + one survey app covers effort, shopping, and dead time without overwhelming you.


Free earning apps are the honest entry point to online income: no investment, real payouts, and lessons in how digital earning works. Start with the one that matches your daily routine, give it a consistent month, and remember the ladder — task apps teach you that earning online is real, and platforms like[GroMo](https://gromo.in/?ref=gromo.in) turn that habit into income that actually matters.


## FAQ: Free Earning Apps


**Which is the best free earning app in India?**


GroMo is the strongest overall free earning app because its rewards are bank-paid commissions rather than points — Rs 500-2,000+ per approved financial product referral, with free registration and training. Among reward apps, Google Opinion Rewards is the most trustworthy, CashKaro is the most effortless (cashback on shopping you already do), and EarnKaro has the highest ceiling for active deal-sharers.


**Are daily earn money apps legit?**


The ten in this guide are legitimate: they are free to join, run by verifiable companies, and pay to UPI, bank, or recognised gift cards. The legit test for any daily earning app: no joining fee ever, a published payout method and minimum, and rewards tied to real actions. Apps promising fixed daily income for taps or requiring deposits to unlock withdrawals are scams.


**Which free earning app is best for students?**


Students do best with apps that pause freely during exams: Google Opinion Rewards and PollPe for dead-time surveys, TaskPlanet for micro-tasks, CashKaro for hostel shopping, and GroMo for meaningful income — helping classmates open savings accounts and first credit cards earns commissions that beat any task app, with no targets interfering with studies.


**How much can I earn from free earning apps without investment?**


Reward and survey apps realistically pay Rs 200-5,000 per month depending on time invested — genuine pocket money, not salary. Cashback and deal-sharing apps like CashKaro and EarnKaro range Rs 200-15,000 based on shopping volume and sharing consistency. Commission platforms are the exception: GroMo partners earn Rs 5,000-30,000+ monthly because each referral pays hundreds to thousands of rupees.


**How do I download and start a free earning app safely?**


Download only from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store — never from APK links shared in Telegram or WhatsApp groups. Check the developer name, rating, and review count; sign up with just your phone or email; and give payment details limited to your UPI ID for payouts. If any app asks for money, card details, passwords, or OTPs, uninstall it immediately.


## Disclaimer


Nothing here is a guarantee of income. All earning figures are indicative estimates; actual results depend on your time, consistency, and each app's live offers, which change frequently — always check the current rewards, payout minimums, and terms inside each app before relying on them. GroMo commissions are set by the partner banks and financial institutions, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications — check the live commission in the GroMo app before relying on any figure. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above.


Everything above is general information, not financial advice. All app names and trademarks belong to their respective owners; inclusion is not an endorsement of every offer they run. Never pay a fee, share an OTP, or hand over financial passwords to any earning app.
